triage coverage: 2 problem(s) reported, 2 classified as a defect class, 2 carried an explicit `kind` tag. Unclassified ones are recorded as judgement calls and owe no answer — which is also what a deck in a language the keyword sets do not cover looks like from here.
the design plan sets `icon_family: none`, and the reader saw ZERO icons across all 5 slides. Either they never reached the build, or they are too small/faint to register.
findings.resolution: Refuted: the literal numeric arrays deliberately contain zero pictograms, as declared by icon_family and its separate rationale.
findings.refuted: The plan declares icon_family none and icon_rationale explains that the exact numeric identities and fixed positions should not be replaced with pictograms. The independent reader counted zero icons on all five actual images, exactly matching this intent. The comparator uses the raw nonempty string at compare() line545 as a planned icon family instead of its own planned_icon_family() none-normalizer. This is a false positive in this pinned checker; no planned asset is missing. The checker is preserved unchanged.
